rule: Every defect (found by a human, reviewer, dogfood run or guard) is classified and mapped to the cheapest durable guard that would have caught it everywhere: a lint/AST rule, a DS primitive constraint, a shared test helper, a frontend-skill rule, a dogfood mission assertion, a search-relevance fixture or a benchmark-library entry. Measure per week: found by humans vs caught by guards. `node scripts/component-certificate.mjs --guards` validates the registry and prints the weekly counts.

defects.title: Connect Spotify dialog asks the already-connected artist to search again

guard.ref: providerDialogReadsConnectionBeforeSearch(renderDialog): a provider connect dialog must render connected state, not a search, when the provider is already linked (planned in the SpotifyConnectDialog job)

defects.title: Search 'tim whi' returns Watt White, Tim McGraw, Waves Of Time and not Tim White

guard.ref: fixture: query 'tim whi' with a candidate pool containing Tim White must rank exact/prefix-name and already-linked or likely artist first (planned in the search-ranking job)

defects.title: Box in box in box: dialog card, bordered panel, bordered input, bordered results
Triple-redundant copy: subtitle, panel label and description, paste-URL link say the same thing

guard.ref: copy-redundancy check in scripts/design-frontend-skill-check.mjs (dialog title/description/label token overlap above threshold, validated against the existing copy corpus before enforcing)

defects.title: Primary 'Connect Spotify' button enabled with nothing selected

guard.ref: primaryActionDisabledWithoutSelection(renderDialog): a dialog whose primary action needs a selection renders it disabled or absent until one exists

defects.title: No visible loading, empty, error or no-match states for search; no keyboard hints

guard.ref: certificate criterion `states` (story per reachable state) plus benchmark pattern command-and-keyboard

defects.title: Add-release drawer loses typed characters and focus; Escape resets the form

guard.ref: findJank rules input-reset:effect-resets-on-open-state and focus-loss:inline-component, plus the input-retention test requirement in the frontend-rules criterion

defects.title: Ovie Product page used hand-built text tabs and decorative lifecycle pills instead of the canonical segment control and a status pipeline

guard.ref: apps/web/tests/unit/design-system/ovie-ia-registry.test.ts (every Ovie page matches data/appScreens/ovie-ia.ts; sub-navigation only through AdminPage views/tabs) and canonical-nav-metric-ratchet.test.ts adHocTabs/adHocRouteNav/localMetricComponent

defects.title: Metrics rendered a bare n/a when a source had not answered, hiding whether data was missing, stale or broken

guard.ref: apps/web/tests/unit/design-system/canonical-nav-metric-ratchet.test.ts barePlaceholder (shrink-only); MeasuredValue is the only unknown/stale owner
